title: Add user profile editing (update name) for signed-in users

requirements.text: Add a user-facing way for an authenticated user to edit their profile (at minimum, update their display name) after initial onboarding.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is signed in, there is a visible entry point labeled "Edit Profile" available from the main UI (e.g., header or account area).
Selecting "Edit Profile" opens a dialog or page that pre-fills the current saved name (if any) and allows changing it.
Submitting the form saves the updated name via the existing profile save flow and shows a success message.
After saving, any UI that depends on the caller profile reflects the updated name without requiring a full page reload.
If the user is not authenticated, the edit profile entry point is not shown (or is disabled with a clear sign-in requirement).

requirements.text: Ensure profile editing uses the existing backend profile API and does not introduce new backend endpoints unless strictly necessary.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile edit flow calls the existing backend method for saving the caller profile (no duplicate APIs).
No backend state schema changes are required for this feature.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components must be composed, not modified).
Do not edit immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if a stable state upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Adding editing capabilities for generation history records (re-edit/touch-up) beyond what already exists.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
